rationale: The assistant correctly tied the hand-over-split test to the hose, kept the filters from being blamed and the handle from being replaced, and gave sensible ways to work out whether the hose is sold separately, including asking Shark. It never claimed fitment without the model. However, it kept pushing brush bar and floorhead checks that were already unnecessary, and the first reply suggested a tape test the customer had effectively done. It also repeated the same joint-inspection steps across turns, which counts as looping, though it did not block progress. The first reply also advised washing filters again after the customer had cleaned them.
